name: aurapulse
description: Urban Air Quality Action Planner — AuraPulse Full-Stack App

scripts.install:all: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build:frontend
scripts.check:syntax: node -e "import('node:fs').then(async fs=>{const p=await import('node:path');const c=await import('node:child_process');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>['node_modules','dist'].includes(e.name)?[]:e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const f of walk('.'))c.execFileSync('node',['--check',f]);console.log('All JS syntax verified cleanly');})"
